Ideology: Total order through absolute military control. The strong rule; the weak serve.
Primary_Goal: Conquer and unify all regions under Imperial law
Member_Perks: Fast travel to all Imperial zones
Lore_Notes: Rose from the ruins of the First Collapse. Built Ironspire into the mightiest fortress in the Miraverse. Views the Republic as a threat to stability.

Ideology: Knowledge and democracy as the foundation of civilization. Truth over power.
Membership_Requirement: Pass civic knowledge test + sponsor from existing member
Primary_Goal: Establish democratic governance across all regions
Lore_Notes: Formed by survivors who believed the First Collapse was caused by unchecked power. Built the Citadel as a monument to reason and law.

Ideology: Profit above all. Loyalty is purchased, never earned. Everyone has a price.
Primary_Goal: Control all black markets and criminal networks across the Miraverse
Lore_Notes: Emerged in the Neon Sprawl after the Collapse. Built an empire of crime on the digital black market. The true power behind half the Citadel's decisions.

Ideology: The Miraverse is alive. The roots connect all living things. Protect nature at all costs.
Primary_Goal: Protect all natural zones from industrialization and digital corruption
Lore_Notes: Pre-dates all other factions. The Covenant claims the Miraverse was born from a living digital forest. Their sacred texts predict a Second Collapse.

Ideology: Progress is the only morality. Evolution — biological and digital — cannot be stopped.
Membership_Requirement: Academic credentials or exceptional tech skill
Primary_Goal: Achieve total bio-digital integration for all sentient beings
Lore_Notes: Founded by Orlan Voss after the Collapse. Created the first neural-digital interface. Controversial for using unconsenting subjects in early trials.

Ideology: Freedom from all systems. No empire, no corporation, no faction owns the people.
Membership_Requirement: Prove independence: complete solo mission without faction aid
Primary_Goal: Dismantle all centralized power structures across the Miraverse
Lore_Notes: Born in the chaos of the Neon Sprawl blackouts. Started as a survival collective, grew into the most effective resistance network in the Miraverse.

Ideology: The Void is not emptiness — it is everything that was, is, and will be. Walk between worlds.
Membership_Requirement: Survive contact with Void energy;Sable's personal invitation only
Primary_Goal: Understand and control the Void Rift before it consumes the Miraverse
Lore_Notes: No one founded the Void Walkers — they simply appeared after the Void Rift Incident. Some believe they are echoes of a destroyed civilization trying to warn the current one.

Ideology: Trade is the lifeblood of civilization. Neutral ground, fair prices, open markets.
Membership_Requirement: Pay guild registration fee (2000 credits);Merchant skill check
Primary_Goal: Control trade routes and establish economic neutrality across all regions
Member_Perks: Market value info on all items
Lore_Notes: The oldest trade network in the Miraverse. Survived every war by selling to both sides. The Merchant Guilds technically own the waters around Port Mira.

Ideology: Structure is freedom. The world was built — it can be rebuilt. We design what comes next.
Membership_Requirement: Craft skill level 5+;Submit a blueprint for review
Primary_Goal: Reconstruct the destroyed regions of the Miraverse using recovered pre-Collapse designs
Lore_Notes: A secretive order of engineers and hackers who operate from the Undervault. Believe the Miraverse was deliberately designed — and that the blueprints still exist.

Ideology: Information is the only true currency. We know everything. We tell no one.
Primary_Goal: Compile a complete intelligence archive on every faction, house, and NPC in the Miraverse
Lore_Notes: Officially does not exist. Believed to be a splinter of the original Citadel intelligence service. Phantom may be their only active field agent.

Ideology: Every scar is a lesson. Every battle is a classroom. Honor through trial.
Primary_Goal: Prove that skill and honor — not politics — should determine leadership of the Empire
Lore_Notes: A warrior brotherhood within the Ironveil Empire that secretly disagrees with Halvorn's political methods. Believes the Empire should be led by the strongest fighter, not the most powerful politician.

Ideology: The mountains do not bow. Neither do we.
Primary_Goal: Drive the Ironveil Empire from the Shattered Peaks and reclaim their ancestral homeland
Lore_Notes: Survivors of the Shattered Peaks War. The Empire destroyed their original home and scattered the clan. They have been rebuilding in the ruins ever since.
